at least 792 bytes, applied as the requirement 'capacity' (feeds Q8 only). record_t is a 20-byte header (magic, zeros, zeros_inv 4 bytes each; crc and version 2 each; seq 4) plus out_store_t, uint16 slots[LINK_OS_COUNT] and chan_cfg[LINK_CC_COUNT] with 4 registers a slot and 4 a channel (firmware/iomcu/src/out_store.c:99-107; out_store.h:64-67; link_pages.h:92-94, :125-127). Today 8 slots and 8 channels (link_pages.h:75-76) give 148 bytes. The 20-port record is not defined (IOBoard.md:248); with a slot per port, 20, and 27 channels (19 single-channel ports plus 8 on the one port switched to PPM, IOBoard.md:64, :250) one record is 20 + 2 x (20 x 4 + 27 x 4) = 396 bytes. The store keeps the record from before a save readable while the next is written (out_store.c:30-33), so it holds 2 records: 792 bytes
